items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to hip injury; McVay says not making great progress and team being cautious though not long-term.
items.why: Hip/groin soft tissue; DNP Wed/Thu; McVay cautious comments
items.implication: Likely miss second straight game vs Broncos; Adams target monopoly continues
items.opportunity: Routes/targets funnel to Davante Adams (42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua; 8-195-2 in prior miss)

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring strain (Grade 1 reports); missed Week 2, DNP Wed/Thu
items.implication: Expected miss vs Colts; Schultz saw 28% target share prior absence
items.opportunity: TE Dalton Schultz and remaining WRs elevated targets

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR; expected knee surgery ending 2026 season (ACL intact).
items.why: Knee injury requiring surgery; full recovery but season over
items.implication: Giants turn to backup QB; offense ceiling down, Nabers/others impacted
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming or Giants skill upside variance

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice; aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half, hasn't practiced full since. Ravens to Brazil. DNP second day.
items.why: Recurring hamstring; DNP Wed/Thu, looking like second consecutive miss
items.implication: Ravens WR volume to Bateman/others; travel complicates return
items.opportunity: Secondary Ravens WRs and TE share increase

items.text: After good MRI results, Saquon Barkley (stinger) is on the practice field suited up; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Stinger, good MRI, participating and expects play
items.implication: Full or near-full workload expected; reverse prior handcuff elevates
items.opportunity: Maintains RB1 role; limited Bigsby/Shipley if limited

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role, AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 utilization, 38% RZ target share; WR9 PPG since Week 11 last year.
items.why: Strong usage + RZ role; Reed out boosts further
items.opportunity: Red-zone and deep targets increase without Reed

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most TE yards.
items.opportunity: High target share and TE-friendly defense

items.text: TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd blown chance/ceded to Kaleb Johnson? Penix healthy enough to revive London/Pitts? Reed absence more 2-TE? Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.why: Role/health uncertainty on TNF; opportunity shifts
items.implication: Monitor Penix for London/Pitts bounce; Watson elevated without Reed; Lloyd downgrade risk
items.opportunity: London/Pitts target revival if Penix healthy; Watson/2TE volume; Johnson backfield lead

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush defense + high prop
items.implication: Smash RB1 spot in Brazil game
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs weak DAL front

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: High volume + aDOT vs soft secondary
items.opportunity: Air yards monopoly and YAC potential

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; RB37 utilization.
Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: Seattle fewest fantasy pts to WRs, 7.9 YPR allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17.
items.why: Tough matchup + low team total (Daniels injury context)
